title: BAE taps Leonardo DRS for next-gen THAAD seeker sensor
big: 17 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: cyber & information and drones & air autonomy.

stories.h: BAE taps Leonardo DRS for next-gen THAAD seeker sensor
stories.what: Leonardo DRS will develop a next-generation infrared sensor for the THAAD missile defense interceptor under a contract from BAE Systems, the company said in a release on Thursday.
stories.you: Leonardo DRS just put THAAD in play. Treat the announcement as intent until a contract or an appropriation follows.

stories.h: Navy Awards 28 Spots on $7.1B SEWIP Contract
stories.what: The Navy has awarded 28 companies a potential $7.13 billion contract for Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program upgrades.

stories.h: BAE opens UK’s first fully automated artillery shell plant
stories.what: BAE Systems has opened a new explosive filling plant at Glascoed in South Wales that it says will raise its capacity to make 155mm artillery shells sixteen-fold, the company said in a release on Friday.

stories.h: Louisiana Air Guard swaps airstrike unit for cyber squadron
stories.what: The Louisiana Air National Guard has turned its 122d Air Support Operations Squadron, a unit that called in airstrikes for ground troops, into a cyber defense squadron, the Louisiana National Guard said this week.
